description: This file defines the S3SignatureV4 class which provides Amazon S3 specific signature version 4 signing support, including methods for signing requests and presigning URLs, with special handling for certain S3 endpoints.

classes.name: S3SignatureV4
classes.description: A class that implements Amazon S3 signature version 4 signing, including request signing and presigning functionalities.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request for Amazon S3, adding necessary headers and choosing signing method based on endpoint.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Handles signing the request using V4a signing scheme, creating a signing configuration with specific options.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a pre-signed URL for the request, adding content hash for data integrity.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Returns a constant indicating an unsigned payload for presigned URLs.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Adjusts the path component for the canonical request, avoiding double encoding for S3.
